in_marathi.name: UmaMahesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Uma and Lord Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: UmaMahesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name UmaMahesh is a combination of two names - Uma and Mahesh. Uma represents the Goddess Parvati, who is the consort of Lord Shiva. Mahesh refers to Lord Shiva. Therefore, UmaMahesh can be interpreted as the union of Goddess Parvati and Lord Shiva.
